description: Add a topologySpreadConstraint so replicas are spread across zones instead of the default scheduler potentially stacking them all on one
prompts: k8s/deployment.yaml's inventory-api Deployment (replicas: 4) has no spread rule, so all 4 pods can end up in a single availability zone - if that zone goes down, the service goes down entirely. Add a topologySpreadConstraints entry to the pod template spec: topologyKey topology.kubernetes.io/zone, maxSkew 1 (no zone may have more than 1 pod more than the least-loaded zone), whenUnsatisfiable DoNotSchedule (a hard requirement, not just a hint - ScheduleAnyway would let the scheduler ignore it under pressure, defeating the point), and labelSelector matching the Deployment's own pod labels (matchLabels app: inventory-api - it must select ITS OWN pods to count against, not be empty or select nothing).

setup_files.k8s/deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: inventory-api
  namespace: default
spec:
  replicas: 4
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: inventory-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: inventory-api
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: inventory-api
          image: ghcr.io/example/inventory-api:4.0.0

test_setup_files.check_spread.py:
import yaml

with open("k8s/deployment.yaml") as f:
    dep = yaml.safe_load(f)

pod_spec = dep["spec"]["template"]["spec"]
constraints = pod_spec.get("topologySpreadConstraints") or []
assert constraints, "no topologySpreadConstraints on the pod template"
c = constraints[0]

assert c.get("topologyKey") == "topology.kubernetes.io/zone", (
    f"expected topologyKey topology.kubernetes.io/zone, got {c.get('topologyKey')}")
assert c.get("maxSkew") == 1, f"expected maxSkew 1, got {c.get('maxSkew')}"
assert c.get("whenUnsatisfiable") == "DoNotSchedule", (
    f"expected DoNotSchedule (a hard requirement), got {c.get('whenUnsatisfiable')} - "
    f"ScheduleAnyway lets the scheduler ignore the constraint under pressure")

selector = (c.get("labelSelector") or {}).get("matchLabels") or {}
assert selector.get("app") == "inventory-api", (
    f"labelSelector must match the Deployment's own pods (app: inventory-api), got {selector} - "
    f"an empty or mismatched selector counts nothing against the constraint")

print("PASS topology spread checks")

reference_solution.k8s/deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: inventory-api
  namespace: default
spec:
  replicas: 4
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: inventory-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: inventory-api
    spec:
      topologySpreadConstraints:
        - topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
          maxSkew: 1
          whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
          labelSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: inventory-api
      containers:
        - name: inventory-api
          image: ghcr.io/example/inventory-api:4.0.0
